messages:
Liam - Infra Manager: Hey @people-ops — we have an engineer transferring teams mid-cycle and the IC wants their promotion considered on the original team evidence. Is that allowed?
Ava - People Ops: Short answer: maybe. Longer: depends on timing + who owned the work/evidence. We usually require manager sign-off on the evidence package for the team that did the work.
Noah - Eng: To add context — most of the project work was with my old team but I accepted the transfer last week. Can my old manager submit the evidence, or does the new manager need to own it?
Ava - People Ops: Old manager can prepare the evidence, but the new manager must endorse in the packet and confirm calibration mapping. We need a clear statement of contributions and overlap dates.
Liam - Infra Manager: Cool. What about effective date? The transfer date is 3/10, the promo window closes 3/15. Payroll cutoff is 3/20 right?
Priya - Payroll: Payroll cutoffs are bank-specific, but for salary changes to reflect on the next pay period we have two internal deadlines: compensation system sign-off by 3/16 23:59 UTC and payroll file submission by 3/20 18:00 PT. If sign-off misses 3/16 we can do retro adjustments but it'll be in the following cycle.
Ava - People Ops: For fairness, we suggest: 1) old manager uploads evidence now; 2) new manager writes endorsement + confirms calibration bucket; 3) people-ops reviews and flags exceptions. If everything green, set effective date as transfer date (3/10) only if approvals hit before sign-off cutoff (3/16).
Noah - Eng: If approvals slip to after 3/16, what's the expected retro timeline and communication?
Priya - Payroll: Retro pay will be processed on the next payroll after the files are corrected — typically 1 pay period later. We notify the employee and manager via email and cc people-ops with the retro amount and reason.
Ava - People Ops: Also note international folks: currency conversions and tax forms can delay things. If the IC is international, we need Employment Ops involved early. Please DM me the country and start date and I'll loop them in.
Liam - Infra Manager: Understood. There's also a leveling exception request (the IC's role maps differently across orgs). How do we route that?
Ava - People Ops: Use the normal leveling exception form (link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/leveling-exceptions). In the form include: short rationale, list of evidence docs, manager endorsement, org mapping, and suggested effective date. We'll triage in the weekly calibration meeting. If urgent, mark "escalate" and @Ava will ping calibration chairs.
HR Bot: Reminder: Calibration meeting this Friday 10:00am PT. Submit exceptions 48h before meeting for guaranteed review. :calendar:
Noah - Eng: Sample evidence snippet I'm attaching here (paste):
```
- Project: KV cache optimizer
- Role: Lead engineer (design+perf)
- Dates: 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-15
- Impact: 30% latency reduction for 2 models, savings estimate $18k/mo
- Reviewers: Sergio (old mgr), Priya (new mgr endorsement pending)
```
Ava - People Ops: Perfect. Couple of tips: 1) quantify impact (cost/latency/customers affected), 2) include PR links and code reviewers, 3) show growth signals (mentoring, cross-team influence). That shortens calibration deliberation.
Liam - Infra Manager: If the exception is denied, what's fallback? Roll the promo to next cycle? Keep comp with spot bonus?
Ava - People Ops: Typically next steps are: 1) offer targeted comp actions (spot bonus or off-cycle increase) depending on severity and budget, or 2) defer promotion to next full cycle with documented expectations. We avoid unplanned band moves without calibration approval.
Priya - Payroll: Heads up — spot bonuses have their own approval path and payroll schedule. Give us advance notice if you think that's likely.
Noah - Eng: Thanks — I'll start the form and collect docs. Who should I CC for international hires?
Ava - People Ops: CC: Employment Ops (employment-ops@redwood.com) + payroll. I'll add a checklist in the exception form notes to remind managers about country-specific paperwork.
Liam - Infra Manager: Great, thanks. I'll get the old manager to draft evidence today and loop Priya and Ava. :thumbsup:
Ava - People Ops: Thanks — ping me if you want a quick 1:1 walkthrough of the form.
HR Bot: Action logged: exception_form_started by Liam. Thread closed pending submission. :white_check_mark:
